status: Approved read-only study and standalone prototype completed; no new production/harness implementation or hosted dispatch
objective: Find a shared cause for nineteen nonwinning pointwise rows before another production qualification
findings: Production already uses CpuParallelSettings.LightweightParallel and vectorized raw OHLC finite checks. Do not redo those integrations.

The pinned tensor span API exists. Add/Subtract/Multiply/Divide had no bit mismatches in the deterministic numerical screen; capture, overflow, presence, history, runtime and worker integration are not thereby verified.
Pinned SIMD Sin/Cos fail the existing accuracy contract even at input1. Sin(1) returns0.8414710097001764 versus Math.Sin0.8414709848078965. Do not adopt these approximate kernels.

The available tensor source uses scalar Math calls inside several vector wrappers. Its current source revision is not assumed equal to the pinned package. No performance conclusion follows from a vector method signature.

All nineteen owned benchmark adapters copy values, copy presence, create a nullable intermediate, then project values and bool presence. Three intermediate arrays account for roughly320KB payload at10000bars. Final owned arrays and builder Full history remain necessary.

A standalone direct span-projection prototype matched the actual frozen publisher for111824 values/presence pairs and111824 ownership checks, including signed zero, NaN payloads, infinities and missing flags. This validates projection only.

Retained CPU profiles show substantial LINQ/GC cost in representative adapters. Spin CPU samples do not bound end-to-end savings. Earlier ungated component medians are not qualification or native-win evidence.

adversarial_review: A harness repair changes the measured workload. Both source labels must use exactly the same repaired harness and fresh native controls. Historical results cannot establish improvement across harness versions.
Apply the helper only to the three named owned adapters; changing the common nullable publisher would extend to unrelated consumers.
Preserve flags>0 exactly, including NaN/negative/zero behavior. Preserve all published NaN bits and independently owned outputs after run disposal.
Do not reuse indicator metadata or switch to LatestOnly to make the adapter faster.
Do not start the190case full batch-family refresh merely because this prototype is correct. A representative end-to-end native pilot and separate bounded report-methodology decision are required.
A future production SIMD study should begin with arithmetic and include capture/validation/history cost. Passing a raw numerical model does not establish arbitrary-input safety or speed.
